Q1.author_route: Frangi-centered deterministic pipeline; RF/SVM/XGBoost explored but rejected after poor transfer
alternatives: small interpretable classifier on component features after source-grouped split
compact pretrained segmentation only if label volume and holdout evidence justify it
not_recommended: LSTM/temporal model without repeated longitudinal images
large deep segmentation on 10 images without external labels and source-group holdout
Q1.why_select: no-label deterministic pipeline is stable under tiny sample size; the paper itself exposes source overlap leakage in ML
Q1.switch_condition: promote learned segmentation only after deduplicated original-image/borehole holdout shows material gain

Q2.baseline: connected components/DBSCAN + fixed P=pi*D + robust fit + reject
Q2.author_route: morphology + DBSCAN + initial sinusoid + anomalous-block removal + refined fit, P=94.25 mm
alternatives: HDBSCAN/topology-based instance grouping followed by fixed-frequency linear IRLS
not_recommended: free-period four-parameter fit when borehole circumference is calibrated
accepting every optimizer output without residual/missingness gate
Q2.why_select: the known borehole geometry makes period identifiable and reduces degrees of freedom
Q2.switch_condition: free P only after quantified unwrap/distortion calibration shows the circumference contract is violated

Q3.baseline: ordered centerline + canonical Z2/JRC + equal-distance/equal-arc sensitivity
Q3.author_route: JRC plus sampling-density and equal-arc comparison
alternatives: multi-scale wavelet diagnostic without redefining JRC
not_recommended: adding correction factors without independent calibration
Q3.why_select: simple physical profile and sampling sensitivity are reproducible and interpretable
Q3.switch_condition: promote adaptive/multiscale correction only with external truth or held-out calibration

Q4.baseline: deterministic plane geometry + transparent compatibility score + Monte-Carlo sensitivity + feasible coverage placement
Q4.author_route: Monte-Carlo plane perturbation + angle/distance score + IDW uncertainty + three-hole recommendation
alternatives: Bayesian posterior connectivity with calibrated likelihood
robust scenario ensemble with worst-case/quantile placement
not_recommended: treating angle mean or self-normalized Monte-Carlo score as calibrated probability
calling IDW spread posterior uncertainty without update model
Q4.why_select: Monte Carlo is useful for propagation, but probability semantics require calibration
Q4.switch_condition: upgrade to probability/EIG only when observation model and labeled/likelihood evidence exist
